name: manual_4d61aa
claim: Enclose env file values that may contain a dollar sign in single quotes or escape the dollar sign with a backslash: double quotes or unquoted values still expand dollar characters in sourced shell files, silently emptying or mangling the key; and reference one working key by alias from another file instead of keeping a second copy of a dead key.

decisions.notes: CodeRabbit on PR 523: correct_lesson leaves corrections provisional by design; promote the single-quote/escape dollar-sign correction into an accepted superseding lesson so recall and LESSONS.md stay aligned.
